decisions.reason: The battery voltage range and connection to AXP2101 do not alter the existing overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The source does not change the battery NTC sensing method or its J_BAT connection.
The source message's 5V boost mapping is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the battery-interface change requires no additional update.
The source message's OR-ing method, sources, and source-selection behavior are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The standalone LDO activation, rating, powered scope, and programming purpose are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source message's conditional 5V LED supply and GPIO3-controlled rail are already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE.
Routing the battery into AXP2101 does not change the established VMID-to-VSYS topology or VSYS net labeling.
The battery input range and AXP2101 destination do not affect the power-board USB-C connector or its sourceability constraints.
The source does not change the charge-status indicator, CHGLED connector, resistor values, or component-population rules.
The electrical battery range and AXP2101 destination do not change any board dimensions, orientation, connector placement, or mounting constraints.
The battery-interface modification does not change the required eight-layer stack.
The source does not alter the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
